description: In front of you are a green plate with a slice of bread, plus several toy sandwich pieces nearby: red and white spreads, an egg, a green lettuce leaf, a brown patty, a yellow cheese slice, and green cucumber rounds, with another bread slice off to the upper right. The right hand brings a bread slice onto the plate, then the left hand and right hand alternately pick up and place layers—red and white spread, egg, lettuce, patty, cheese, and cucumber—stacking them neatly on top of the bread while the other hand steadies the pile, and the right hand reaches toward the extra bread slice at the end.
